notes: Direct page fetches were blocked by the sandbox egress policy (harborfreight.com, manuals.harborfreight.com and all maker sites), and the shared web-search budget ran out partway through this article, so facts come from the kit fact table, the fact-check notes (Part 3.6) and earlier search summaries. Please re-check against the HF page/manual: (1) 9-1/2 in ram stroke (from fact-check notes only); (2) support-bar positions 8-1/2, 11-1/4, 12, 16-3/4, 19-1/2, 22-1/4 in (from HF's go.harborfreight.com coupon page summary); (3) manual wording on anchoring, eye protection, keeping hands clear and not heating pipe (from a search summary of the manual); (4) Central Machinery brand / item 32888 (fact-check notes). Owner reports of kinking tube are described qualitatively from forum threads. Left out as unverified: weight, dimensions, warranty, alternate SKUs 62539/86013, availability channel (fact-check notes say in-store only; the FAQ just says sold direct and to check availability), and any price.
